lines.text: The LORD tells Moses that a jealous husband with no proof must bring his wife to the priest with a barley flour offering.
The priest has the woman stand before the LORD, lets down her hair, and places the grain offering in her hands.
The priest puts holy water in a clay jar and adds ashes of a red heifer to it.
The woman answers the curse with Amen, Amen, and the priest writes the curses on a scroll and burns it on the altar.

wrong_details.true: wash them off into the bitter water

lines.text: The husband will be free from guilt, but the woman shall bear her iniquity.
